title: streamline-tenant-dryrun-bridge-and-staged-upgrade-safety.json
author: Ana Rodriguez
release_notes:
- Add tenant-scoped dry-run preflight mode that validates values overlays without mutating cluster
- Introduce a cross-namespace 'bridge' init job for secret/ConfigMap bootstrap during upgrades
- Add upgrade-safety-probe CRD template and corresponding Helm values to gate automatic rollouts
- Extend values.schema.json with modules/overlays and stricter type checks for network and storage configs
description:
Title: Streamline tenant dry-run, bridge init stage, and upgrade safety probe

Motivation and context: Private deployments require careful, tenant-aware preflight checks and safe upgrade paths to avoid accidental secret leakage or failed rollouts in air-gapped and VPC deployments. This PR introduces a tenant-focused dry-run mode for the Helm chart, a dedicated 'bridge' init stage that runs in a control namespace to copy minimal bootstrap artifacts across tenant namespaces safely, and an upgrade-safety-probe resource to explicitly gate automated upgrades. These changes were driven by ENG-4023 and an on-call incident summarized in OPS-77.

Description (single continuous body): This change set introduces three complementary pieces: 1) values.schema.json extensions and helpers to support module overlays and tenant-scoped preflight dry-run; 2) a templating pattern that adds a 'bridge' initJob which can be optionally enabled to perform secret/ConfigMap bootstrapping across namespaces (useful for on-prem where a shared control plane artifact needs to be mirrored without granting full RBAC); 3) an upgrade-safety-probe that emits a short-lived CRD/Job allowing operators to define a readiness gate before automated rollouts. The Helm values include clear knobs: private.preflight.dryRun (boolean), private.bridge.enabled (boolean), private.bridge.controlNamespace (string), private.upgradeProbe.enabled (boolean), private.upgradeProbe.timeoutSeconds (int). The schema validates these fields and enforces module overlay shape when modules.* is used. The templating includes a new helper _bridge.tpl which constructs a safe serviceaccount + rolebinding scoped to the controlNamespace and a small job that copies only allowed keys (whitelist) from source to destination namespaces. An optional init stage weight is added so operators can sequence the bridge before tenant init containers.

- Marcus Liu (request changes): "We should gate the bridge job behind an explicit RBAC knob and default to disabled in the chart. Also add unit tests that verify secret keys are filtered by whitelist to avoid accidental PII copying."
- Ana Rodriguez (author): "Agreed; added private.bridge.enabled and private.bridge.allowedKeys. Added helm template test covering whitelist behaviour. See commit 3b2f7a7."
- Priya Menon: "Docs example is helpful; can we add a short troubleshooting bullet about common RBAC errors operators see with the bridge SA?"
- Ana Rodriguez: "Added a troubleshooting section and example Role manifest that operators can copy/paste. Also added a note on how this interacts with KMS-backed secrets in private installs."
- Liam Carter (approve): "Verified render tests locally and CI. Approving pending green CI."

CI Summary:
- ci/helm-lint: pass

- ci/unit (chart tests): pass
- ci/docs-lint: pass
- Full suite: All checks passed after addressing a flakey test; rerun completed successfully.

Upgrade and migration notes: The change is opt-in. Existing installs are unaffected (bridge disabled, preflight dryRun off). Operators can enable private.preflight.dryRun to run a non-mutating validation that uses Helm template rendering and simple Kubernetes dry-run APIs. If operators enable bridge, they must provide a controlNamespace that the installer has access to; the PR includes a migration guide for converting an existing init flow to the bridge-based flow.

Testing performed: Local helm template validations, chart unit tests, CI matrix on k8s 1.25 and 1.26 runners, manual smoke test in a VPC dev cluster verifying bridge copies only whitelisted keys and upgrade-safety-probe gates rollback when failing.

Backward compatibility: Values defaults preserve existing behaviour. Schema changes mark new keys as optional; if modules overlay is used, additional validation applies. No breaking API changes.

Merge details: Squash merged into main on 2026-03-01 by Priya Menon with commit message: "streamline: tenant dry-run, bridge init stage, upgrade safety probe (ENG-4023)"

Follow-ups:
- ENG-4090: Add automated RBAC validation step to preflight pipeline (follow-up ticket)
- OPS-79: Add a short-run canary to validate bridge behaviour in staging clusters before enabling in production

If you want to exercise the feature quickly: examples/priv-install-with-bridge.yaml contains a small reference that shows enabling private.bridge and running helm template --set private.preflight.dryRun=true to validate configuration without applying changes.

End of PR description.
